PARTIALSURRENDEROFLEASE THIS INDENTURE, made the 3o? day of August, 2004, between THE 29 E. 54 ST My y/002 2 party of the first part, and THE 400 EAST 54TH STREET COMPANY, the party of the second part, both having offices at 429 East 52nd Street, New York, New York 10022, WHEREAS, Trebuhs Realty Co., Inc., as Landlord, by a certain lease (the "Ground Lease") dated as of January 1, 1969, leased unto Julius Perlbinder, as Tenant, the premises (the "Demised Premises") described on the annexed Schedule A, a memorandum of which lease was recorded in the New York County office of the Register of the City of New York on December 17, 1968, at Reel 125, page 1626; and WHEREAS, the tenant's interest in the Ground Lease was assigned by mesne assignments to the party of the first part most recent such assignments, dated December 13, 1972, having been recorded in the New York County office of the Register of the City of New York on December 15, 1972, at Reel 262, page 10; and WHEREAS, the Ground Lease was modified by agreement dated January 20, 1971, between Trebuhs Realty Co., Inc., and the party of the first part; which agreement was recorded in the New York County office of the Register of the City of New York on June 28, 1971, at Reel 208, page 1344; and WHEREAS The Shubert Organization, Inc., having by corporate merger obtained the interest of Trebuhs Realty Co., Inc., as Landlord, in the Ground Lease, by agreement dated November 1, 1984, assigned the Landlord's interest therein to The Shubert Foundation, Inc., which assignment was recorded in the New York County office of the Register of the City of New York on November 12, 1985, at Reel 983, page 1240; and HFNY2:#781977 v.1#01533-0001 08/23/2004

WHEREAS The Shubert Foundation, Inc., by agreement dated June 27, 1985, assigned Landlord's interest in the Ground Lease to the party of the second part; which assignment was recorded in the New York County office of the Register of the City of New York on July10,1985,atReel935,page189; NOW THESE PRESENTS WITNESSETH, that for and in consideration of the sum of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other valuable consideration paid by the party of the second part to the party of the first part, receipt of which is hereby acknowledged, and for the intent and purpose that the said term in the certain portion of the Demised Premises as are described on the annexed Schedule B (the "Surrendered Premises") be wholly merged and extinguished, the party of the first part has given, granted, and surrendered, and by these presents does give, grant, and surrender unto the party of the second part, and release from the terms provisions and obligations of the Ground Lease, the Surrendered Premises, and all the estate, right, title, interest, term of years, property, claim, and demand whatsoever of the party of the first part, in, to, or out of the said Surrendered Premises, or any part and parcel thereof. TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the said Surendered Premises to the party of the second part, its successors, and assigns, to their own proper use and behoof, forever free, clear, and discharged of and from all lien and claim under and by virtue of the Ground Lease. Ground Lease, which is and hereby is made subordinate in lien, title, and interest to the Declaration described in the annexed Schedule B, shall otherwise continue in full force and effect.
